column1: # Amazon Redshift token forms for generated compat rows: the text written for
# each value RedshiftDocs.g4 names by class, where the docs write a value in
# italics or in lower case. Keywords and punctuation are literals in the
# grammar and need no row. Sources, read 2026-11-13:
# A sample of one name, string or number stands for its class when the docs
# judge reads a statement; a keyword or a sample of several tokens stands for
# itself. (reserved) marks a word the docs judge never reads as a name.

column3: standard identifier: an ASCII letter or _, then letters, digits, _ and $; a "delimited" one is a name too
an expression; the command pages give no expression grammar, so a constant
a query; the command pages give no query grammar beyond SELECT's synopsis
a data type; INT is INTEGER's alias (r_Numeric_types201.html)
a WITH clause's common table expression, CTE_table_name AS ( query ) (r_WITH_clause.html)
schema_element: a statement that creates an object in the schema (r_CREATE_SCHEMA.html)
